title: Settling Patient Pay Across a Resident's Medical Assistance Cases
content:
**Clause.** Under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage, patient pay is settled across all of a resident's cases: a credit balance on one case is applied to open patient pay on the resident's other case, oldest service month first, before any of it is refunded, and only the remainder is refunded. The remainder is refunded within the refund days set for the product.

**The same clause, condition by condition.**

| Situation on the resident's file | Treatment of the credit |
|---|---|
| A credit on one case and open patient pay on the resident's other case | applied to that open patient pay first, oldest service month first |
| Credit left over after the other case's open patient pay is cleared | the remainder is refunded |
| A credit on one case and no open patient pay on any other case of the resident | refunded |

**Hypothetical worked example.** A resident's closed earlier case shows a credit of 212.40 dollars. The resident's current case has open patient pay of 96.15 dollars for one service month and 140.00 dollars for the following month. The credit is applied first to the older month (96.15 dollars, leaving 116.25 dollars), then to the following month (116.25 dollars of the 140.00 dollars, leaving 23.75 dollars of that month open). Nothing remains to refund. Had the current case shown only the older month open, 116.25 dollars would have been refunded.
